scope: Synchronous detached preparation and complete save intent capture for one ordinary single-select component in a managed new-document candidate.

authority.goal: Dashboard/Artifacts/DT_DM-478391 【2026年8月】仪表盘-功能优化合集/S02-F01/Goal.final.json
authority.design_review: Dashboard/Artifacts/DT_DM-478391 【2026年8月】仪表盘-功能优化合集/S02-F01/reviews/QuerySingleSelectDesignCarrierLifecycleDesignReview-r003.md

operations.input: Explicit JSON-only queryRoot, KEEP outerRoot, componentId, revision/expectedRevision and commitId.
operations.success: Returns detached designRoot/runtimeRoot retaining all outer fields and applying carrier design/runtime fields to exactly one matching component.
operations.side_effects: None; no source authority minted, no store writes, events, requests or history.

operations.input: Explicit JSON-only componentData/canvasStyleData/canvasViewInfo/appData/dvInfo/checkVersion/contentId plus queryDesignOverlay (null or detached design projection tied to one component and commitId).
operations.success: Returns detached complete payload, applying the supplied design projection to exactly one component before cleanup, plus save/update method, target and current name-check parameters, SHA-256 intentDigest over canonical full payload excluding contentId and checkVersion.
operations.side_effects: None; does not mutate inputs, send requests, bind create identity or clear dirty.

invariants: deeply detached output and input unchanged
prepare requires exact current revision and exactly one target
save capture removes top-level GroupArea and clears linkageFilters only on UserView, Group children and DeTabs children in its copy
dvInfo.name is trimmed on copy and must be 1..64 characters when supplied
payload preserves full current fields and sets watermarkInfo null
method is updateCanvas only when id exists and optType is not copy; otherwise saveCanvas
name-check parameters are derived from captured payload
digest is canonical SHA-256 and excludes only contentId/checkVersion
when queryDesignOverlay is supplied, apply its propValue/cascade only to exactly one target in captured componentData; reject absent/ambiguous target and leave input unchanged
write_exclusions: network execution, server outcomes, dirty clearing
claim_ceiling: M0 pure module candidate only; no product lifecycle activation, save behavior, authorization or Goal completion.
